answer.because: The script declares five trailing stop inputs that no code reads, and it locks the take profit to the entry price instead of resending the exit to let winners run past the target as the desk requires.
answer.script:
//@version=5
strategy("Day Shift Delta Volume Breakout", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000)
// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(100, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=50, maxval=700)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=50)
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")

// Fixed dollar stops and moving take profit

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE =====
profile_lookback = input.int(120, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=20, maxval=2000, step=10)
profile_rows     = input.int(10, "Price Levels (rows)", minval=5, maxval=100, step=5, tooltip="More rows = finer resolution but slower.")

// ===== DELTA VOLUME =====
min_delta_pct = input.float(5.0, "Min Delta Imbalance (%)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=5, tooltip="Net delta at POC must exceed this % of total POC volume to confirm direction. 0 = disabled.")

// ===== TREND FILTER =====
vwma_len = input.int(50, "Trend VWMA Length", minval=1)

// ===== ENTRY =====
fractal_len   = input.int(5, "Fractal Length (BOS)", minval=3, maxval=21, step=2, tooltip="LuxAlgo fractal length for BOS detection.")
cooldown_bars = input.int(10, "Cooldown (bars)", minval=0, maxval=100, step=1)

// ===== FILTERS =====
use_vol_filter = input.bool(true, "High Volume on BOS", group="Filters", tooltip="BOS bar must have above-average volume.")
vol_ma_len     = input.int(12, "Volume MA Length", minval=5, maxval=100, group="Filters")

// ===== SESSION =====
use_session   = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter")
sess_start_hr = input.int(18, "Session Start Hour (ET)")
sess_start_mn = input.int(0,  "Session Start Minute")
sess_end_hr   = input.int(16, "Session End Hour (ET)")
sess_end_mn   = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute")

// ===== SKIP WINDOW =====
use_skip      = input.bool(true, "Skip This Time Of Day", group="Skip Window", tooltip="No trade opens inside this window, and an open trade is closed when it starts.")
skip_start_hr = input.int(8, "Skip Start Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Skip Window")
skip_start_mn = input.int(30, "Skip Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Skip Window")
skip_end_hr   = input.int(10, "Skip End Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Skip Window")
skip_end_mn   = input.int(30, "Skip End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Skip Window")

skip_bar_t = hour(time, "America/New_York") * 100 + minute(time, "America/New_York")
skip_from  = skip_start_hr * 100 + skip_start_mn
skip_to    = skip_end_hr * 100 + skip_end_mn
in_skip_window = use_skip and (skip_from > skip_to ? (skip_bar_t >= skip_from or skip_bar_t < skip_to) : (skip_bar_t >= skip_from and skip_bar_t < skip_to))
skip_window_open = not in_skip_window

if in_skip_window and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Skip Window")

// ===== COMPUTED =====
float stop_pts = stop_dollars / pv
float tp_pts   = tp_dollars / pv

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
bar_t  = bar_hr * 100 + bar_mn
int s_start = sess_start_hr * 100 + sess_start_mn
int s_end   = sess_end_hr * 100 + sess_end_mn

bool in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (bar_t >= s_start or bar_t < s_end) : (bar_t >= s_start and bar_t < s_end))

prev_hr = hour(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_mn = minute(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_t  = prev_hr * 100 + prev_mn
bool was_in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (prev_t >= s_start or prev_t < s_end) : (prev_t >= s_start and prev_t < s_end))
bool session_ended = was_in_session and not in_session

if session_ended and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session Close")

// ===== VWMA TREND =====
float vwma_val = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)
// Simple slope check: current VWMA vs previous bar's VWMA
bool vwma_up = vwma_val > vwma_val[1]
bool vwma_dn = vwma_val < vwma_val[1]

// ===== VOLUME FILTER =====
float vol_ma = ta.sma(volume, vol_ma_len)
bool high_vol = volume >= vol_ma

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE WITH DELTA =====
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    // Reset arrays
    if vol_total.size() != rows
        vol_total.clear()
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_total.push(0.0)
    else
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_total.set(i, 0.0)
            
    if vol_up.size() != rows
        vol_up.clear()
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_up.push(0.0)
    else
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_up.set(i, 0.0)
            
    if vol_dn.size() != rows
        vol_dn.clear()
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_dn.push(0.0)
    else
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_dn.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

// ===== BREAKOUT SIGNALS =====
bool above_poc = not na(poc_hi) and close > poc_hi and close[1] <= poc_hi
bool below_poc = not na(poc_lo) and close < poc_lo and close[1] >= poc_lo

bool delta_bull = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct)
bool delta_bear = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct)

// ===== LUXALGO FRACTAL BOS (Market Structure) =====
int p = math.floor(fractal_len / 2.0)
float dh = math.sum(math.sign(high - high[1]), p)
float dl = math.sum(math.sign(low - low[1]), p)
bool bullf = dh == -p and dh[p] == p and high[p] == ta.highest(high, fractal_len)
bool bearf = dl == p and dl[p] == -p and low[p] == ta.lowest(low, fractal_len)

var float upper_value    = na
var bool  upper_crossed  = true
var float lower_value    = na
var bool  lower_crossed  = true

if bullf
    upper_value   := high[p]
    upper_crossed := false
if bearf
    lower_value   := low[p]
    lower_crossed := false

bool bos_bull = not na(upper_value) and ta.crossover(close, upper_value) and not upper_crossed
bool bos_bear = not na(lower_value) and ta.crossunder(close, lower_value) and not lower_crossed

if bos_bull
    upper_crossed := true
if bos_bear
    lower_crossed := true

// ===== ARM ON POC BREAKOUT, ENTER ON FIRST BOS =====
var int armed_dir = 0

if above_poc and vwma_up and delta_bull
    armed_dir := 1
else if below_poc and vwma_dn and delta_bear
    armed_dir := -1

// Disarm if price re-enters POC before BOS
if armed_dir == 1 and not na(poc_hi) and close <= poc_hi
    armed_dir := 0
else if armed_dir == -1 and not na(poc_lo) and close >= poc_lo
    armed_dir := 0

// ===== REVERSAL LOGIC =====
// Track if we just had a stop-out to allow one immediate reversal
var bool allow_reversal = false
var int last_exit_bar = -9999
var int last_exit_type = 0 // 1: Long Stop, -1: Short Stop

// Detect stop-out
bool long_stop_hit = strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] > 0 and close[1] <= strategy.position_avg_price[1] - stop_dollars / pv
bool short_stop_hit = strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] < 0 and close[1] >= strategy.position_avg_price[1] + stop_dollars / pv

if long_stop_hit
    allow_reversal := true
    last_exit_bar := bar_index
    last_exit_type := 1
else if short_stop_hit
    allow_reversal := true
    last_exit_bar := bar_index
    last_exit_type := -1

// Reset reversal flag if a trade completes normally or after a long time
if strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] != 0 and not long_stop_hit and not short_stop_hit
    allow_reversal := false

// ===== FILTERS =====
bool vol_ok = not use_vol_filter or high_vol

// Determine if entry is allowed based on reversal logic
// Normal entry: armed_dir matches signal
// Reversal entry: allow_reversal is true, and signal is opposite to last_exit_type, and it's the next bar? 
// Plan: "allow one opposite-direction reversal trade on the next confirmed breakout"
// This implies if we were stopped out long, we can enter short on the next valid short signal without needing to re-arm? 
// Or does it mean we can enter short immediately if the conditions are met? 
// "on the next confirmed breakout" suggests we still need the breakout signal (BOS), but maybe we bypass the "arm" requirement?
// The plan says: "Enter on the next pivot confirmation (BOS) in the armed direction." 
// And "Reversal: After a full stop-out, allow one opposite-direction reversal trade on the next confirmed breakout, then require a normal arm until the next stop-out."
// This implies the "arm" state might be bypassed or immediately satisfied for the opposite direction.
// Let's interpret: If allow_reversal is true, and we get a signal in the opposite direction of the stop-out, we allow it.
// We must ensure we only use this once.

bool confirmed_long  = armed_dir == 1 and bos_bull and vol_ok
bool confirmed_short = armed_dir == -1 and bos_bear and vol_ok

// Check reversal conditions
bool reversal_long_allowed = allow_reversal and last_exit_type == -1 and bos_bull and vol_ok
bool reversal_short_allowed = allow_reversal and last_exit_type == 1 and bos_bear and vol_ok

// Combine signals
bool long_sig  = (confirmed_long or reversal_long_allowed) and in_session and skip_window_open and strategy.position_size <= 0
bool short_sig = (confirmed_short or reversal_short_allowed) and in_session and skip_window_open and strategy.position_size >= 0

// Cooldown
var int last_trade_bar = -9999
bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_trade_bar >= cooldown_bars

if long_sig
    long_sig := cooled_down
if short_sig
    short_sig := cooled_down

// ===== ENTRIES =====
if long_sig
    last_trade_bar := bar_index
    armed_dir := 0
    allow_reversal := false // Consume the reversal allowance
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if short_sig
    last_trade_bar := bar_index
    armed_dir := 0
    allow_reversal := false // Consume the reversal allowance
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== RESET AFTER TRADE =====
if strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] != 0
    armed_dir := 0

// ===== PLOT =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", vwma_up ? color.lime : vwma_dn ? color.red : color.gray, linewidth=2)
plot(not na(poc_price) ? poc_price : na, "POC", color.yellow, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot(not na(poc_hi) ? poc_hi : na, "POC High", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plot(not na(poc_lo) ? poc_lo : na, "POC Low", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)

bgcolor(not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo) and close >= poc_lo and close <= poc_hi ? color.new(#2962FF, 90) : na)

plotshape(long_sig, "Long Signal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_sig, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.small)
plotshape(bos_bull and armed_dir == 1, "BOS Bull", shape.flag, location.abovebar, color.new(color.lime, 20), size=size.tiny)
plotshape(bos_bear and armed_dir == -1, "BOS Bear", shape.flag, location.belowbar, color.new(color.red, 20), size=size.tiny)

plot(not na(poc_delta_pct) ? poc_delta_pct : na, "POC Delta %", color.orange, display=display.data_window)

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)
